evidence.quote: After seeing considerable progress on slowing inflation last year, we have not yet seen further progress this year.
I remain willing to raise the target range for the federal funds rate at a future meeting should the incoming data indicate that progress on inflation has stalled or reversed.
my baseline outlook continues to be that inflation will decline further with the policy rate held steady, but I still see a number of upside inflation risks that affect my outlook.
Recent employment reports continue to show a tight labor market, and the unemployment rate remains below 4 percent
I expect inflation to remain elevated for some time.
